overview.title: Famous Scientists & Astronomers Who Changed Our View of the Universe
overview.description: Brilliant minds who unlocked the cosmos

ancientAstronomers.name: Aryabhata
ancientAstronomers.contribution: Earth rotates on its axis, calculated Earth's circumference
ancientAstronomers.legacy: Pioneer of Indian astronomy and mathematics

ancientAstronomers.name: Al-Biruni
ancientAstronomers.contribution: Calculated Earth's radius accurately, studied astronomy and physics

renaissanceRevolution.name: Nicolaus Copernicus
renaissanceRevolution.revolutionaryIdea: Heliocentric model - Sun at center, not Earth
renaissanceRevolution.quote: Finally we shall place the Sun himself at the center of the Universe

renaissanceRevolution.name: Tycho Brahe
renaissanceRevolution.contribution: Most accurate astronomical observations before telescope
renaissanceRevolution.specialty: Measured planet positions with incredible precision
renaissanceRevolution.legacy: His data helped Kepler discover planetary laws
renaissanceRevolution.funFact: Lost his nose in a duel, wore metal prosthetic

renaissanceRevolution.name: Galileo Galilei
renaissanceRevolution.revolutionaryIdea: Used telescope to prove heliocentric model
renaissanceRevolution.trial: Church forced him to recant heliocentric views
renaissanceRevolution.quote: And yet it moves (referring to Earth)

renaissanceRevolution.name: Johannes Kepler
laws: Planets orbit in ellipses, not circles
Planets move faster when closer to Sun
Relationship between orbit size and period

enlightenmentGiants.name: Isaac Newton
enlightenmentGiants.impact: Explained motion of everything from apples to planets
enlightenmentGiants.quote: If I have seen further, it is by standing on the shoulders of giants
enlightenmentGiants.apple: Apple falling inspired gravity theory (maybe myth)

enlightenmentGiants.name: William Herschel
enlightenmentGiants.also: Infrared radiation, many nebulae and double stars
enlightenmentGiants.achievement: First new planet discovered since ancient times

modernAstronomy.name: Albert Einstein
revolutionaryIdeas: General Relativity (1915) - gravity is curved spacetime
modernAstronomy.impact: Revolutionized understanding of space, time, gravity
predictions: GPS wouldn't work without his equations
modernAstronomy.quote: Imagination is more important than knowledge
modernAstronomy.icon: Most famous scientist ever, synonymous with genius

modernAstronomy.name: Edwin Hubble
modernAstronomy.impact: Changed our understanding of universe size
modernAstronomy.legacy: Hubble Space Telescope named after him
modernAstronomy.achievement: Proved universe is much bigger than thought

modernAstronomy.name: Carl Sagan
modernAstronomy.quote: We are made of star stuff

modernAstronomy.name: Stephen Hawking
achievements: Best-selling book: A Brief History of Time
modernAstronomy.despite: Lived 55 years with ALS (motor neuron disease)
modernAstronomy.quote: Look up at the stars and not down at your feet
modernAstronomy.icon: Symbol of human perseverance and intellect

contemporaryLeaders.name: Neil deGrasse Tyson
contemporaryLeaders.impact: Making science cool for new generation

contemporaryLeaders.name: Vera Rubin
contemporaryLeaders.achievement: Proved most of universe's mass is invisible
contemporaryLeaders.legacy: Vera Rubin Observatory named after her

contemporaryLeaders.name: Jocelyn Bell Burnell
contemporaryLeaders.controversy: Male colleagues got Nobel Prize, she didn't
contemporaryLeaders.achievement: One of most significant astronomical discoveries

contemporaryLeaders.name: Andrea Ghez
contemporaryLeaders.achievement: Proved supermassive black hole at Milky Way center

contemporaryLeaders.name: Michio Kaku
contemporaryLeaders.famous: Books on future of humanity, string theory

womenPioneers.name: Henrietta Swan Leavitt
womenPioneers.legacy: Foundation for Hubble's universe expansion discovery

womenPioneers.name: Cecilia Payne-Gaposchkin
womenPioneers.discovery: Stars are mostly hydrogen and helium
womenPioneers.achievement: Called 'most brilliant PhD thesis in astronomy'

womenPioneers.name: Annie Jump Cannon
womenPioneers.system: Stellar classification system still used today

womenPioneers.name: Caroline Herschel
womenPioneers.first: First woman paid for scientific work

womenPioneers.name: Nancy Grace Roman
womenPioneers.role: First Chief of Astronomy at NASA
womenPioneers.legacy: Roman Space Telescope named after her

womenPioneers.name: Mae Jemison
womenPioneers.achievement: First African American woman in space (1992)

nobelPrizes.physics: Many space-related discoveries win Nobel Prize in Physics

astronauts: Chris Hadfield (Canada) - ISS commander, guitarist in space
Scott Kelly (USA) - Year in Space mission
Peggy Whitson (USA) - Most time in space for American
Tim Peake (UK) - First British ESA astronaut to ISS

nextGeneration.message: Who will be the next Einstein, Hawking, or Sagan?
nextGeneration.encouragement: Every great scientist started by looking up at the stars and asking 'why?'
